concept.title: Performance sub-tab
concept.shortdesc: In the Performance sub-tab, you can plot the RMS (Root Mean Squared) of the raw

conbody.p: In the Performance sub-tab, you can plot the RMS (Root Mean Squared) of the raw data for vibration X, Z axes (acceleration [m/s2], velocity [mm/s] and displacement [um]). You can also view the magnetic field, and the mean value for speed and temperatures (of both motor frame and environment). A set of the above data is acquired every 40 minutes since the SMS device is first activated.
